What If It Looked Like This?

2D
  • God portraits with action poses
  • Emphasis on iconography
  • A new, modern perspective on iconic gods
3D
  • Painterly, cartoonish
  • Dark, gloomy environments
  • Heavily saturated highlights

What if we hid a world full of
secrets and mystery inside an
autobattler roguelike?

Atlas’s thread of fate was cut short,

and the layers of the cosmos didn’t just break — they collapsed into each other.

Sky, earth, and underworld, mashed together in one drowned, vertical ruin, half-submerged in the black water from before creation;

making way for the Primordials to take your place at the end of the world.

Final Spark is a 3D discovery-centric autobattler roguelike where you recruit a team of mythological gods to take down Primordials at the end of the world.

Find and reweave the golden threads of fate through a vast array of secrets and mysteries hiding within an autobattler roguelike system.
